Background

About Me

I'm Jade A. Jaballa, a fourth year graduating student of BS in Computer Science from the Visayas State University, Baybay City, Leyte. I'm a DOST-JLSS Scholar and University Dean's Honor student, which reflects my commitment to academic excellence in the field.

My approach to programming is rooted in careful analysis — I enjoy breaking down complex problems and building reliable, maintainable solutions. I've worked across mobile (Flutter), web (Vue/Nuxt), and machine learning (Python) — and I'm always eager to learn what's next.
